instruction: Take Thunderbird and Google Chrome off your favorites dock.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires removing both thunderbird.desktop and google-chrome.desktop from the favorites dock, leaving only vim.desktop. Initial setup creates favorites list ['thunderbird.desktop', 'vim.desktop', 'google-chrome.desktop']. After removing Thunderbird and Chrome, the expected result is ['vim.desktop']. Uses existing check_gnome_favorite_apps metric which compares sets (order-independent).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_vm_command_line executes 'gsettings get org.gnome.shell favorite-apps' to retrieve the current favorites list state
Metric logic is correct: check_gnome_favorite_apps correctly parses the output string, checks both length and set equality to verify the favorites list contains only vim.desktop
Complete coverage: The evaluator verifies the complete requirement - that both Thunderbird and Chrome are removed, leaving only vim.desktop
Expected value is semantically correct: ['vim.desktop'] matches the desired state after removing both applications
Data flow is correct: Command output (string) -> metric parses and compares -> verifies against expected list
No state timing issues: gsettings command always reflects current system state, no postconfig needed
